spire.name: Nighthaven
spire.lore: The druid sanctuary of Nighthaven in Moonglade, home of the Cenarion Circle, the Moon Well and Keeper Remulos. No enemy dares the sacred lake.

zoneMechanic.name: Sanctuary
zoneMechanic.text: No combat in Moonglade. Entering the hub restores 30% of your missing HP, a rest is guaranteed, and class trainers sell card upgrades.

rest.name: The Moon Well
rest.text: Rest beside the Moon Well of Nighthaven.

trainer.name: Class Trainer
trainer.text: Buy a card upgrade (next spell rank) for gold.

events.name: Class Trainer
events.text: Your class trainer in Nighthaven teaches the next rank of your spells, for a fee.

events.name: Nighthaven Vendor
events.text: A Cenarion Circle vendor sells potions, spell tomes and trinkets to those who rest in Nighthaven.

events.name: Timbermaw Passage
events.text: The tunnel from Moonglade leads through Timbermaw Hold to Felwood. The furbolgs here accept those who bring tribute.

events.name: Keeper Remulos
events.text: Keeper Remulos, the demigod of Moonglade, grants a blessing to those who face the end of the war.

options.label: Receive the blessing (+6 max HP, heal 10)
Ask about Eranikus (+1 Strength this spire)
